verdict.rationale: Vanta documents an integrations catalog that connects cloud infrastructure, version control, productivity tools and identity providers (vanta-docs-26), with named connectors such as AWS (40+ resources), Azure, Okta, GitHub and Wiz (vanta-docs-10, vanta-docs-40). MDM appears only as an API-driven category (vanta-docs-32), and homegrown systems need a custom push (vanta-docs-2). Missing for 10: any evidence of read-only or least-privilege scopes, explicit HR and ticketing integrations, native MDM connectors, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
